controller_policy.name: upstream_level_hysteresis_v1
controller_policy.status: Predetermined hypothetical operating policy; not optimized or calibrated
controller_policy.rate_basis: Illustrative analogue to USACE rule-operation example 0.1 ft/min = 0.000508 m/s; not a measured actuator specification
controller_policy.head_basis: Upstream pool elevation minus its existing gate sill; identical relative-head thresholds for both branches
controller_policy.slew_basis: At each scheduled update choose a rate-limited endpoint; actual opening moves linearly to that endpoint during the next 120 seconds. Small movements use less than the maximum rate.
controller_policy.selection_basis: Low-water hysteresis and energy-gate target ratios provide an applicability buffer; full opening is requested 0.4 m below the unchanged dam limit. Values declared before simulations.
